Serving Omaha Metro

Clearing out an entire house is a massive undertaking. Whether you're preparing a home for sale, managing an estate, or dealing with a hoarding situation, the sheer volume of stuff can be overwhelming. A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service provides professional house cleanout services in Omaha and the surrounding areas. We handle everything from single-room clearouts to whole-property transformations, including the attic, basement, and garage.

We've helped families across Omaha, Bellevue, and Papillion clear out homes that have been lived in for decades. We understand that these jobs often come during difficult times, like a death in the family or a stressful move. Our crew is respectful, efficient, and thorough. We don't just haul away the big furniture; we clear out every drawer, every closet, and every corner until the house is completely empty and ready for whatever comes next.

Our Cleanout Process

Free On-Site Estimate

We'll walk through the property with you to understand the scope of the job and provide a firm, upfront price. No hidden fees, no surprises.

Sorting and Removal

Our crew handles all the heavy lifting. We sort items for donation, recycling, and disposal, ensuring that as little as possible ends up in the landfill.

Broom-Swept Finish

Once the junk is gone, we sweep the floors and ensure the property is left in a clean, manageable state for your next steps.

Before: A cluttered closet packed with years of accumulated items before our A1 Junk Removal crew arrived.

Estate and Hoarding Specialists

We specialize in the most challenging cleanout situations. For estate cleanouts, we work closely with executors and family members to ensure that any items of value or sentimental importance are set aside while the rest of the property is cleared. In hoarding situations, we provide a compassionate and non-judgmental service, working at a pace that is comfortable for the client while still achieving the goal of a safe and clean living environment. We've seen it all, and we have the experience and the equipment to handle even the most extreme cases of accumulation.

Ready for Sale or Rent

Our goal is to get the property into "market-ready" condition as quickly as possible. Real estate agents across Omaha recommend us because they know we can turn a cluttered house into a clean, empty space in a matter of days. By removing the junk, we allow potential buyers or tenants to see the true potential of the home. If you're a landlord dealing with a tenant who left a mess, we can provide a fast turnaround so you can get the unit back on the market and minimize your vacancy time.

After: The same closet completely cleared and broom-swept, ready for the next chapter.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a full house cleanout cost in Omaha?

Pricing depends on the volume of junk and the labor required. We provide free, no-obligation estimates. Because we are locally owned, our rates are typically 40-60% lower than national franchises.

Do you handle hoarding situations?

Yes. We have extensive experience with hoarding cleanouts. We work respectfully and efficiently to clear the property while being mindful of the sensitive nature of these jobs.

Can you clear out a house after a death in the family?

Yes, we specialize in estate cleanouts. We can work with family members or executors to clear the entire property so it can be prepared for sale or rent.

Do I need to be present for the cleanout?

Not necessarily. As long as we have access to the property and a clear understanding of what needs to be removed, we can handle the entire process and send you photos of the completed work.
